correctness.rationale: The affine Binet identity is determined by the initial data and recurrence. Five distinct exponential bases are certified by four explicit norms; the Vandermonde is a unit over the p-adic finite etale algebra, yielding the iff coefficient criterion. Divisibility reduces to 5k and lambda^k-1. Odd-prime lifting with d_p prime to p, and the exact p=5 order-six valuation, prove every stated quantifier. 6900 independent exact finite valuation checks and 219 square-recurrence checks corroborate but do not replace the proof.
